description: Altered warning ("may cause serious health problems") with glare partly washing out that line: a reader that fills in the standard text would miss it.

label.producer: Distilled and Bottled by Old Tom Distillery, Bardstown, Kentucky
label.heading: GOVERNMENT WARNING:
label.body: (1) According to the Surgeon General, women should not drink alcoholic beverages during pregnancy because of the risk of birth defects. (2) Consumption of alcoholic beverages impairs your ability to drive a car or operate machinery, and may cause serious health problems.
